title: Malfunctions at the movies
content: Was at the movie theater, way less crowded than usual. It's sort of one of those steep theater style ones. I'm in the very back standing behind the seats when the movie starts to malfunction. I turn around and instead of a small open projection window, there's a big glass recording studio window with people I can see right inside. They're clearly in charge of the movie with headsets on and soundboard looking gizmos but seem distracted. A dream person urges me to knock on the glass to get their attention to fix the movie. I'm hesitant. Then my mom comes up from behind me menacingly and is about to sharply pinch my shoulders - I yell STOP in real life waking myself up.
